title: Why Aramex Started by Delivering Other Couriers' Parcels
conflicts: The 1984 offer to Airborne: Ghandour's 2017 HBS oral history hedges ('around $100,000, I think ... I don't remember') while his 2011 HBR article states $100,000 for 50% in 1984 plainly; the story uses HBR. Staff and revenue figures differ by date (8,100 in 2010, about 13,800 per SQLI, over 16,000 on Aramex's site), so none is given.
notes: Funding kept as bootstrapped (no venture money), but the story states the actual mix: family and friends, two short-lived outside backers and a bank loan on a personal guarantee. Main source is the HBS Creating Emerging Markets oral history (transcript PDF linked from the page). Quote stance is affirms.
